// Negative case (run by TestGoSourceBridgeSliceRetainedRefusal, not the
// differ): slice storage nested inside another value cannot be reconciled by
// the buffer writeback and keeps the retention refusal. Native Go accepts this
// program; the interpreter must refuse it promptly rather than hang or corrupt.
//
// Sprint 165 (runtime-1): the original shape, reflect.DeepEqual over nested
// slices, now RUNS — DeepEqual is a read-only structural reader (it retains
// nothing and writes nothing), so it left the refusal class by mechanism
// (interp/testdata/sprint165/runtime-1/reflect-readonly/). The pinned shape
// is a dependency that MUTATES the nested storage: slices.Reverse of the outer
// slice, which the buffer writeback cannot reconcile.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"slices"
)

func main() {
	a := [][]int{{2, 1}, {0}}
	slices.Reverse(a)
	fmt.Println(a)
}
